descriptions.agent_templates: Reusable RetellAi agent blueprint; maps to a physical Retell agent_id. Has a type and a description.
descriptions.agent_template_variables: A template's configurable fields. Self-referential parent_agent_template_variable_id enables conditional/nested variables (parent_option gates the child).
descriptions.ai_agents: A configured agent instance built from a template — phone_number, voice_id, agent_trigger, and pre/post call hooks (JSON).
descriptions.ai_agent_variable_values: Per-agent value for each template variable. Join of ai_agent x agent_template_variable (unique pair).
descriptions.users: Application users. Fortify auth + two-factor (secret, recovery codes, confirmed_at).
descriptions.failed_jobs: Dead-letter store for exhausted queue jobs.
